text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I went out to have fun in a nearby big city—
and spotted Yukino Bijin in front of a vending machine, struggling with something.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, beats me. I heard ya could use
these IC cards at vending machines too, though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... Focus, focus! Knowing how to properly use
city folk tools like this is what makes a
proper "City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems she wants to buy a drink
with her IC card app,
but doesn't know how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Man, as expected of you, Trainer! I see, so you press the button beforehand, huh!
choice_data_list: So you came to play too?
Did you come here to play too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I figured if I wanna become a "City Girl,"
I gotta get used to the city first, y'know?
So I was plannin' on checkin' out some city-like spots.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, now that I'm actually here, everything's way too big-city for me... I don't have the faintest clue where to go.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I had trouble even buying a drink,
and now I'm feeling kinda discouraged...
Maybe I should just head back and try again another day.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, shall I go with you?
If you'd like, shall I go with you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's mighty kind of ya...!
With Trainer-san by my side, I feel as strong as a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how 'bout recommending
a spot that feels totally "Big City!" to you?
choice_data_list: Wanna check out a more obscure spot?
Want to check out a more obscure spot?
Let's go somewhere with a view of the whole city.
How about some window shopping?
How about window shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how 'bout recommending
a spot that feels totally "Big City!" to you?
choice_data_list: Wanna check out a more obscure spot?
Want to check out a more obscure spot?
Let's go somewhere with a view of the whole city.
How about some window shopping?
How about window shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: D-Deep...? Sounds like somethin' mighty impressive...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at the flagship store
of a famous shop that sells Umamusume
and racing-related merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hae~, even off the racetrack, there are shops
like this right in the middle of town...
The big city sure is somethin' else...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this place is insanely huge.
Just how big is it, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: If I remember correctly, it should be the entire floor of this building.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Whaaah?! T-That's a whole 'nother level of digits...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"This is definitely worth checking out!
I bet City-san's merchandise is displayed in tons of prime spots!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Man, look at the size of this place...!
I gotta get my head in the game
and search properly... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Digital-san!
Just the dependable person I wanted to see!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wahaa!? Y-Y-Y-Yukino-san!?
Guaaah, a sneak attack of pure-hearted aura!!
My soul is burning up!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, m-my apologies! *inhale-exhale*!
Did you need something from Digitan?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well... it's a bit embarrassing, but
I'm really not used to big fancy stores like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just need a rough idea, so it'd be a big help
if you could tell me a little about
what's being sold where.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
! I see...!
So you want to enter this world too, Yukino!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! That's right, gansu!
Today is pretty much an intro!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Understood! That's true, nowadays online shopping leaves nothing to be desired, but nothing beats browsing an actual physical store!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly, Digi-tan, will gladly guide you through every corner,
across all generations, JRA and NAR alike, with my whole heart and soul!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, you'd go that far for me!?
Much obliged! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Being able to cruise through fancy shops like this has gotta be what makes a real 'City Girl'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was very "City Girl"-like or not...
Yukino Bijin thoroughly enjoyed the deep subculture world
under Agnes Digital's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so this is one of those
scenic city spots! I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? W-Well knock me down with a feather!
That huge buildin' looks
like it could fit right in the palm of yer hand...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's always a bigger fish, ain't there?
So this is what a skyscraper looks like...!
Man oh man, what a sight...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well now, I sure got to see somethin' great! As expected of a Trainer who's used to the big city!
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Man, though... what is this feeling? Even with such an amazing
view, it feels strangely nostalgic too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's it! It looks just like when I used to gaze out over the streets of Morioka from the mountain observatory as a kid!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I could see the whole giant city all at once... It made me so hyped, wanting to visit every single place that caught my eye!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Thass right. Ain't no reason to get cold feet.
Just gotta be honest, like I was back then!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! I wanna walk around even more!
Explore this amazin' city with my own two feet!
choice_data_list: Feels like you've gotten a bit used to the big city.
Feels like you've gotten a bit used to the big city.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ehehe... Well now, wonder if that puts me one step closer to bein' a "city girl."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! How about we look out from here
and decide where to go next?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Come on, over here!
Let's take a look through the telescope together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Yukino Bijin spent the entire day exploring the city, looking quite satisfied with having taken a step forward as a "city girl."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now that's classic!
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa-aaah...! It's so huge...!
Every single shop looks so fancy and all...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, no good, no good.
Backing down like this ain't cool at all!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A "City Girl" would strut around
with her head held high! Alrighty...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just like walkin' through the Morioka shopping mall...
Off to battle I go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Man, we really saw a whole bunch of places. I wonder if I've gotten a little used to the city vibe now... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Man, there are so many people though...
I'm getting a little tired.
Maybe somewhere I could take a quick rest—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Whaat's that?
That nostalgic smell—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
La France pears, Jajamian noodles, yogurt... Wh-What is all this!?
There's so much stuff from back home right here!
choice_data_list: It's like an Iwate specialty shop.
It's like an Iwate specialty shop.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haeee...! Wow, this brings back memories, it does...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer,
these cold noodles are so deliiicious!
Let me get one as a souvenir—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Man, I never thought I'd run into something from my hometown in a fancy place like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When you're surrounded by nothing but unfamiliar things,
something like this really soothes the soul, doesn't it—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The big city really runs deep, don't it?
It ain't just fancy, huge,
and glittery all around.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's got a big-hearted warmth that puts even a country bumpkin like me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Somehow, I feel like I've got
a bit of a firsthand feel for the big city now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having learned the city's many faces, Yukino Bijin showed a look of satisfaction... as if she had truly shed her old skin and become a "City Girl."
